title: Beyond Co-Movement: Locality by Exposures Enables a Joint Factor-Graph Framework for Portfolio Diversification
abstract: arXiv:2608.06618v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current portfolio construction methods are either agnostic to the effects of idiosyncratic shocks (standard factor models) or to the latent data structure driving systematic returns (recent graph-based approaches). This presents an opportunity to combine the complementary market aspects captured by the factor and graph domains, allowing asset allocations to operate directly on the underlying market structure, rather than on its observed co-movement or its finite-sample artefacts. In this work, we introduce the Mutually-INformed Graph-Locality and Exposures framework (MINGLE), which mutually regularises the factor and graph domains by redefining graph locality through systematic factor exposure profiles, rather than via observed co-movements. This is formalised through a unified Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) framework that jointly learns a latent factor representation and its induced graph topology directly

translated_title: 超越共动性：基于暴露度的局部性为投资组合分散化启用联合因子-图框架
translated_abstract: 当前的投资组合构建方法要么对特质冲击的影响缺乏感知（标准因子模型），要么对驱动系统性收益的潜在数据结构缺乏感知（近期基于图的方法）。这为我们提供了一个将因子域与图域所捕获的互补市场特征相结合的机会，使资产配置能够直接在底层市场结构上运作，而不是依赖于观测到的共动性或有限样本带来的伪影。在这项工作中，我们提出了互信息化的图局部性与暴露度框架（MINGLE），该框架通过系统性因子暴露特征（而非观测到的共动性）重新定义图的局部性，从而对因子域和图域进行相互正则化。该方法通过统一的交替方向乘子法（ADMM）框架加以形式化，直接联合学习潜在因子表示及其诱导的图拓扑结构。
tldr: 该论文提出MINGLE框架，用系统性因子暴露度而非观测共动性来定义图的局部性，并通过统一的ADMM框架联合学习潜在因子表示与图拓扑结构，从而在真实市场结构上实现更有效的投资组合分散化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the MINGLE framework, which redefines graph locality through systematic factor exposures rather than observed co-movements, and jointly learns latent factor representations and induced graph topology via a unified ADMM framework, enabling more effective portfolio diversification on the underlying market structure.
